lines.prompt: Derive the Boolean equation for output n12 in terms of its primary inputs.

golden.reference: n12 is a registered (sequential) output, so it has no pure primary-input combinational closed form; the trivial answer 'n12 = n12' or its next-state function n12_next = (!n4600 + (!n5842 * (!n4575 + !n4576 + !n4577 + !n4578 + !n4574))) * !n4601 * n4599 (over register outputs treated as pseudo-PIs) are both accepted.
golden.notes: Netlist-verified: n12 is the Q output of dff g2209 (D=n9424), so no PI-only combinational closed form exists; the cone of n9424 terminates on exactly the 9 register outputs n4574-n4578/n4599/n4600/n4601/n5842 and Team7's next-state equation is truth-table equivalent to it. Both accepted forms are anchored by reliable full-score teams: Team3 and Team4 (both 8/8) gave the trivial identity 'n12'; Team7 (8/8) gave the next-state derivation and stated a pure-PI closed form is not well-defined. Team2's log also shows the trivial identity, but Team2's exchanged log is a different run than its graded one, so it is only non-authoritative corroboration. Accept either the trivial identity or a next-state derivation; reject any answer that fabricates a PI-only combinational equation.
